claim: The Euganean Hills Regional Park covers about 18,694 hectares, was established in 1989, has Monte Venda (601 m) as its highest peak, hills of volcanic origin from ~35 million years ago, and spans 15 municipalities.
quote: The park encompasses around 18,694 hectares ... established in 1989. The hills are of volcanic origin created around 35 million years ago (Oligocene). Mount Venda, at 601 m above sea level, is the highest one.

claim: The Colli Euganei comprise about 81 distinctive volcanic hills rising abruptly from the Po plain southwest of Padua.
quote: The Colli Euganei ... form the first Regional Park established in Veneto (1989), occupying an area with a roughly elliptical perimeter ... comprising 81 hills and fifteen municipalities.

claim: Trail No. 9 to Monte Venda is an easy 3.5 km route with only 66 m elevation gain, walkable in under 1.5 hours from Casa Marina visitor centre in Galzignano Terme.
quote: Trail No. 9 is suitable for all, has a length of approximately 3.5 km, limited elevation gain of 66 meters, and requires less than 1.5 hours of walking.

claim: Trail No. 4 (Sentiero G.G. Lorenzoni) is the more challenging Monte Venda loop, ~6 km with 250 m elevation gain, ~2.5 hours, passing the ruined Olivetan monastery near the summit.
quote: loop trail of medium difficulty, approximately 6 km long, with 250 meters of elevation gain and an estimated travel time of 2.5 hours (3 hours with a detour to monastery ruins).

claim: The Alta Via dei Colli Euganei is a 42 km long-distance ridge route with 2,000 m total elevation gain, demanding but technically non-difficult.
quote: The Alta Via dei Colli Euganei, a demanding hike of 42 km with 2,000 m elevation gain that does not require particular technical skills but requires fair training.

claim: Arquà Petrarca preserves the house where Francesco Petrarch lived 1369–1374 until his death, now a museum with frescoed rooms and personal artefacts.
quote: The house where Francesco Petrarch spent his final days has been preserved as it once was ... Francesco Petrarch stayed in the last years of his life, from 1369 to 1374.

claim: Beyond the poet's house and red Verona marble sarcophagus tomb in Santa Maria Assunta churchyard, Arquà has the 12th-century Oratorio SS Trinità, an ancient fountain, and the nearby baroque Valsanzibio garden.
quote: Oratorio SS Trinità e Loggia dei Vicari ... Located at the highest part of town, this 12th-century oratory features the magnificent altar piece by Palma il Giovane.

claim: Arquà Petrarca was named Borgo dei Borghi (Italy's most beautiful village) in 2017, signalling broad popularity with tourists.
quote: In 2017, Arquà Petrarca won the title of Borgo dei Borghi (the best hamlet in Italy).

claim: Abbazia di Praglia, the Benedictine abbey in Teolo, opens to guided visits Mon–Fri 15:00–17:00 and Sat–Sun 15:30–17:30, free with suggested donation (~€5), and the monumental library opens only on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of each month.
quote: Regular opening hours are Monday-Friday 3-5 PM; Saturday 3:30-5:30 PM; Sunday 3:30-5:30 PM ... Access to the monumental library is available on the second and fourth Saturday of each month.

claim: Eremo di Monte Rua is a Camaldolese hermitage at 416 m on a summit above Torreglia, founded in 1339, with 14 cloistered monks' cells, and access restricted to men only outside of Jubilee years.
quote: located on the summit of Monte Rua (416 m above sea level) in the municipality of Torreglia ... A small community of cloistered Camaldolese monks lives here ... access is restricted ... precluded to women.

claim: The Colli Euganei DOC wine zone covers ~1,300 hectares on calcareous and volcanic slopes around Arquà Petrarca, Galzignano Terme and Torreglia, producing reds (Merlot, Cabernet) and the aromatic Fior d'Arancio DOCG.
quote: Colli Euganei is a DOC area ... covers around 1,300 hectares of vineyards on volcanic and highly calcareous mountain slopes ... includes the municipalities of Arquà Petrarca, Galzignano Terme and Torreglia.

claim: The signature Colli Euganei cycling loop is roughly 63 km, mostly flat on bike lanes, encircling the hills through Padova, Este, Abano and Montegrotto Terme — doable in a day.
quote: nearly 63 km almost completely through a bicycle lane with a wonderful view of the Euganean Hills, an easy ride, mostly flat, especially recommended in Spring, Summer and Fall.

claim: Abano and Montegrotto Terme together form Europe's largest and oldest thermal spa district, with over 130 thermal hotels offering day-spa access from roughly €85 per person.
quote: the Thermal Baths of Abano and Montegrotto are the largest and oldest thermal spa in Europe ... Over 130 thermal spas and around 220 baths.

claim: April–May is the prime window for the Colli Euganei: mild 15–20 °C temperatures, blooming wildflowers, plus seasonal sagre and wine festivals tied to the DOC/DOCG.
quote: In spring, mild temperatures (around 15–20°C) and wildflower blooms make it perfect for gentle explorations, short hikes, and village-hopping by car, bike, or e-bike.

claim: A typical car loop strings together Este's 14th-century castle, the Cava Bomba geo-paleontological museum near Cinto Euganeo, Castello di Valbona on Monte Lozzo, Abbazia di Praglia, and the Abano/Montegrotto thermal towns.
quote: Este, with its 14th-century castle and panoramic views of the hills ... the Geo-Paleontological Museum of Cava Bomba near Cinto Euganeo ... Castello di Valbona ... Abbadia di Praglia ... thermal baths of Abano and Montegrotto.
